summary: Deluxe Corp filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Equity Purchase Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Celero Intermediate Holdings LLC and related entity BlockerCo for approximately $625 million in cash, plus seller transaction expenses and adjustments. The transaction involves Deluxe purchasing BlockerCo's equity and merging its wholly-owned subsidiary with Celero. Financing will come from Deluxe's revolving credit facility and debt financing. The filing notes customary representations and warranties, buyer-side R&W insurance, and conditions including antitrust clearance. The board has not disclosed a recommendation. The deal is expected to close in 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. The risk-arb angle centers on financing execution and clearance timing.
